name: C-C motif chemokine receptor 4

function.text: CCR4 encodes C-C chemokine receptor type 4. Annotated molecular activities include chemokine receptor activity and C-C chemokine receptor activity. It participates in chemotaxis and calcium-mediated signaling.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Sézary syndrome; Adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
